subject: MAP internal playbook — Acme evaluation & close timeline prep
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP internal playbook — Acme evaluation & close timeline prep

Team —

Quick internal prep as promised before our external kickoff with Acme next week. High-level goals: align owners on the MAP, lock evaluation success criteria, and close contract terms by end of April. I put a first-pass draft of the MAP and the stakeholder roster in the attachments (draft_map_acme_v0.9.xlsx; stakeholder_roster_acme.csv).

Key asks (please reply inline):
- Review the attached MAP draft for gaps — focus on acceptance criteria and deliverables for the 4-week evaluation.
- Confirm owners (RACI) for the items in the draft. I sketched owners in column G but it needs validation.
- Confirm availability for an internal dry-run: Wed 2027-03-17 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 2027-03-18 09:00-10:00 PT.

Target external kickoff (proposed): Mon 2027-03-22. Target contract signature: 2027-04-30. These are aggressive but realistic if procurement and security cycles run on schedule.

Notes to keep in mind for the MAP: acceptance criteria must include quantitative latency/cost targets and a short list of sample prompts for evals. Procurement milestone needs a named point-of-contact from Acme — we don't have that yet.

Attachments: draft_map_acme_v0.9.xlsx (MAP draft), stakeholder_roster_acme.csv

Thanks — please flag anything you think will block the April 30 close.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Priyom —

Nice start. A couple quick items from CS/partnership perspective:

- Add a Customer Success owner for day-to-day evaluation support (I can own onboarding activities).
- We should add Security/Compliance checkpoints into the MAP (SOC2 evidence + data residency checks) — add a hard stop before the procurement milestone so security can sign off.
- Procurement: we need to build a separate procurement timeline row (PO, SOW, legal review). That usually takes 3 weeks once we have a named contact.

Dry-run: Wed 3/17 10:00 PT works for me.

I'll review the MAP draft this afternoon and annotate acceptance criteria.

—Laura

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP internal playbook — Acme evaluation & close timeline prep

Thanks — I looked through the draft and added a couple technical clarifications. Main points:

- Proposed RACI (high level):
  - Sales Exec Alignment: Priyom (R), Laura (C), Dev (I), Rachel (I)
  - Technical Eval Setup (perf tests, sample prompts): Dev (R), Priyom (A), Laura (C)
  - Security/Compliance Sign-off: Dev (R) for evidence collection, Laura (A) for customer communication
  - Procurement & Contract: Rachel (R), Priyom (A)
  - Pilot success sign-off: Customer PO (A), Laura (R), Dev (I)

- Acceptance criteria (draft):
  1) 95th pct latency < 450ms for representative prompt set (see sheet 'Latency_Bench')
  2) Cost per 1k tokens <= $0.65 under planned batching strategy
  3) Sample throughput: sustain 6 concurrent sessions for 5 minutes without KV cache misses impacting latency

- I've attached the annotated MAP (draft_map_acme_v0.9.xlsx) with comments on the technical runbook and a stakeholder CSV with suggested security contacts.

Two asks for priors before dry-run:
1) Priyom: confirm which sample prompts (3-5) we will use for the external evaluation and put them in the 'Eval_Samples' sheet.
2) Rachel: share any procurement lead info you have so we can map procurement timeline.

I can host the dry-run and walk through the technical checklist. Wed 10:00 PT is fine for me — I'll block 60 mins.

Attachments: draft_map_acme_v0.9.xlsx (annotated), stakeholder_roster_acme.csv (security contacts)

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood-inference.com

Thanks all — good alignment. Quick update and final prep before the dry-run tomorrow.

Decisions / action items:
- Dry-run confirmed: Wed 2027-03-17 10:00 PT (we'll proceed with this slot; several folks confirmed). Dev will host and walk the checklist.
- Owners updated in the MAP per Dev's RACI. I updated Sales Exec alignment row to show Priyom (R/A) and Laura (C).
- Laura: please add the security checkpoint block (SOC2 checklist + required artifacts) to the MAP and put a hard stop before procurement.
- Rachel: please escalate to Acme and request the named procurement contact this morning. If we don't have a contact by EOD Monday, notify me so I can loop in procurement ops.
- Priyom (me): I'll finalize the 3 sample prompts and add them to the 'Eval_Samples' sheet by EOD today (attached).

Related assets: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/4821 — I've updated the 'Deal Timeline' milestone and added the MAP as a linked file (Drive link below).
Drive (MAP v0.9): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AbcDef/view?usp=sharing

Pre-dry-run checklist (short):
- Confirm attendees + Slack channel created for real-time ops (Laura)
- Finalize eval prompts (Priyom)
- Procurement lead confirmed (Rachel)
- Security artifacts mapped (Dev / Laura)

If nothing else, we'll use tomorrow to run the external-facing script and catch any gaps that would block the April 30 close.

—Priyom
